output.title: Ingress pathType change: no Ingress resources visible in environment
output.content: The change switches the Kubernetes Ingress `pathType` from `ImplementationSpecific` to `Exact`. The excerpt does not say which Ingress objects cert-manager creates it applies to. The environment's manifests show only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, so no Ingress is visible, but the summary does not show how challenges are solved. If HTTP-01 challenges are used with an ingress controller, check how the controller treats the changed pathType.
